name: Facet
text: Make the legend a sticky panel anchored to the left edge of the graph. It stays visible as users scroll or zoom, so they never lose context. The trade-off is less screen space for the graph itself, but clarity beats compactness when users need to interpret data quickly.

name: Pane
text: The sticky legend still risks crowding the graph when users zoom into dense data—users lose sight of the data behind the panel. A floating collapsed icon solves space but risks users missing it entirely; the real test is whether users can interpret the graph without hunting for the legend. Settle it with a usability test: measure how often users reference the legend in both designs under real data density.
